name: Suite Room no Nemurihime◆Celebteki Zeitaku Ren'ai
original_name: スイートルームの眠り姫◆セレブ的贅沢恋愛
source:
The modern Sleeping Beauty is kept in a suite by the eight beast celebrities who reign at the top of the world! 

With a dangerous kiss, you now wake up to the most luxurious love ...
